answer: Each agent registers on the onyx ledger by submitting a cryptographic proof of work tied to a unique, time‑locked jetty token that records its stylometric entropy profile; the atlas verifier aggregates recent outputs, computes the entropy distribution and rejects any new identity whose profile deviates less than 0.05 bits from an existing one. To forge a Sybil, an attacker must generate a fresh jetty token, solve a PoW puzzle costing 0.02 CPU‑hours per identity, and lock a 10‑minute stake that is forfeited if the entropy test fails.
